Profit Rescue Analytics

Sales & profitability intelligence dashboard · Detect discount leakage, margin pressure, weak products and regional performance

What this project is about: This is a retail/business profitability analytics project built using synthetic sales, customers, products, inventory, returns and target data. It helps managers identify where revenue is earned, where profit is lost, and which discounts, product categories or regions need attention. Filter or upload refreshed CSV data to update the visuals.

Synthetic demonstration dataset. Charts/KPIs update instantly when you change filters or upload the matching files Sales_Order_Items.csv, Sales_Orders.csv and Products.csv together. This browser dashboard is not automatically connected to MySQL; CSV upload refreshes its local view. For Power BI, refresh data in Power BI Desktop separately.
